lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: The highest-intensity local maxima are arranged in at least four horizontal rows, with the central rows showing a staggered, alternating pattern forming a series of diamond-shaped units posterior to the gills.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Discrete vertical bands of higher pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, creating high-contrast anchor nodes at approximately 90-degree angles across the lateral mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features running from the branchial region towards the caudal peduncle, with the most prominent ridge showing a stark tonal shift from light (top) to dark (bottom).

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: High-luminance blobs are clustered at the base and along the leading edge of the dorsal fin, with a notable absence of spots on the upper-posterior margin.

other_distinctive_markers: The anterior leading edge of the visible pectoral fin displays a high-density cluster of smaller, high-luminance pixels compared to the more uniform spacing on the main flank.
